_note: Current official closures/notices for the DATA-extra (non-state-park) swim spots, verified on 2026-09-19. Only alerts that are still posted on the operator's own page are listed. Closures are data, not code: deactivating a row reopens the park.

alerts.text: Hillsborough County announcement: "Due to high water levels and unsafe conditions, the spring is currently closed for swimming." The rest of Lithia Springs Conservation Park - campground, trails, playground and picnic areas - remains open. No reopening date has been given; the county page was last updated 10 September 2026.

Northwest Florida Water Management District, 8 January 2026: contractors have begun the Cypress Spring shoreline restoration and protection project, adding shoreline stabilisation, boardwalks and steps at the entry and exit points. While the work continues, access to the shoreline may be restricted; the spring itself remains accessible by watercraft. The District said the work was expected to last several months and has not posted a completion notice.
